title: Spiral morphology in an intensely star-forming disk galaxy more than 12 billion years ago
question: When in cosmic history did the distinct internal structures of spiral galaxies (stellar bulge, rotating disk, and spiral arms) form, and are they present in an intensely star-forming galaxy at z = 4.41?

data.sensitivity: [C II]: ~0.35 mJy beam^-1 per 20 km s^-1 channel; dust continuum: ~0.036 mJy beam^-1

evidence.quote: BRI 1335-0417 (QSO J1338-0432), a galaxy at redshift _z_ = 4.4074 ± 0.0015 ( _11_ ), 1.4 Gyr after the Big Bang.
It is classified as a Hyper Luminous InfraRed Galaxy (HyLIRG) with a luminosity of 3.1 ´ 10 [13] _L_ ⊙ ( _L_ ⊙ is the luminosity of the Sun) at far-infrared wavelengths ( _12_ )

evidence.quote: and a high star formation rate of 5 ± 1 ´ 10 [3] _M_ ⊙ yr [-1] ( _M_ ⊙ is the mass of the Sun), estimated from modeling the spectral energy distribution ( _13_ ).

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image dust continuum and [C II] line cube, and generate moment maps
recipe.method: Calibrate visibilities with CASA pipeline, identify line-free channels with hif_findcont, image continuum and UV-subtracted [C II] cube with tclean, and generate moment maps using the masked moment method.
key_parameters: Briggs robust = 0.0 (continuum) and 0.5 ([C II]); channel width = 20 km s^-1; clean threshold = 1.5x rms (continuum) and 1.0x rms ([C II]); moment mask threshold = 7.5x rms in smoothed cube

recipe.goal: Measure disk position angle, inclination, and scale radius
recipe.method: Measure kinematic position angle from central 0.5" of [C II] moment 1 map using PaFit, then fit 2D Sérsic and exponential profiles to dust continuum and [C II] moment 0 images using GALFIT.
assumptions: Thin disk relation q = cos(i) used to convert dust continuum axis ratio to inclination

recipe.goal: Decompose [C II] intensity into logarithmic spiral modes via Fourier analysis
recipe.method: Deproject [C II] moment 0 image to face-on using scikit-image and compute Fourier amplitudes A(p, m) for m = 1, 2, 3, 4 logarithmic spirals.
key_parameters: PA = 4.5°, inclination = 37.8°; radial annulus 1.6 kpc to 7.2 kpc; m = 1, 2, 3, 4; bilinear spline interpolation
assumptions: Polar coordinate center is the peak intensity pixel in the [C II] image

recipe.goal: Extract PVD, measure intrinsic velocity dispersion and rotational support
recipe.method: Extract PVD along kinematic major axis (PA = 4.5°) averaged over one beam width (3 pixels), fit line profiles with Gauss-Hermite h3 and h4 polynomials to measure velocity dispersion, and derive intrinsic velocity dispersion and v_rot from outer disk.
key_parameters: PVD extraction width = 1 beam (3 pixels); SNR > 4 in at least 4 velocity channels required for profile fitting

recipe.goal: 3D gas dynamical modeling of bulge and disk masses
recipe.method: Generate gas particles from CLEAN components using SkySampler, build 3D dynamical model cubes in KinMS with a spherical de Vaucouleurs bulge + thick pressure-supported exponential disk gravitational potential, and fit directly to the observed cube via MCMC using emcee.
key_parameters: R_d = 1.83 kpc; velocity range -390 to +370 km s^-1; N ~ 4 x 10^4 constraints (dof = 42400); 8 free parameters; 180 walkers, 4000 steps, 600 burn-in steps
assumptions: Dark matter halo excluded within 5 kpc; black hole mass included in spherical de Vaucouleurs bulge; axisymmetric exponential disk with R_d = 1.83 kpc; isotropic spatially uniform velocity dispersion; hydrostatic asymmetric drift and disk thickness correction

recipe.goal: Compute spatially resolved Toomre Q parameter of the gas disk
recipe.method: Calculate Toomre Q parameter pixel-by-pixel from epicyclic frequency, intrinsic velocity dispersion, and gas surface density scaled from [C II] distribution and CO(2-1) total molecular gas mass.
key_parameters: M_gas = 5 x 10^10 M_sun; SNR > 4 in at least 4 velocity channels
assumptions: [C II] intensity distribution traces total gas surface density
